name: clear_and_loop_seventeen_times

name: clear_and_loop_sixteen_down

name: set_state_one_and_call

name: build_copper_list_with_end
description: Writes a short Copper-style instruction list into memory through a pointer held in a global: two wait or register-write pairs followed by an end-of-list marker. It also makes calls and stores a pointer in a global variable.

name: fill_table_with_incrementing_values
description: Writes thirty-two pairs of words to memory. Each pair holds a counting value that starts at 384 and rises by two, followed by a zero word.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:96AE
name: decrement_counter_and_store_short
description: When one global variable is zero and another is non-zero, it subtracts 256 from the second and stores it as a short at an offset from a pointer held in a global. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:96E0
name: fill_table_with_hashed_bytes
description: Fills thirty-two word entries in a table, each a twelve-bit value folded from four consecutive bytes of a buffer multiplied by a global multiplier. The final entry is set to zero when a global flag is set, and the routine makes calls before and after the loop.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9744
name: call_subroutine_eight_times
description: Calls one subroutine eight times in a row and then returns. It changes no registers or memory of its own.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:97A2
name: store_four_words_to_table
description: Writes four 16-bit values through the address register: the first word, the upper half of a 32-bit value, the first word plus two, and the lower half of that 32-bit value.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:97B8
name: fill_table_from_code_pointers
description: Fills five four-word table entries. Each entry holds a counting word, the two halves of a 32-bit longword read from consecutive code addresses, and a word two less than the counting word.

name: swap_globals_and_call_twice
description: Swaps the contents of two global variables and then calls another routine twice in a row.

name: scan_marker_store_address
description: Scans forward through memory for a two-word marker pair, then stores the address just past the marker in a global variable.

name: unpack_rle_stream_into_buffer
description: Unpacks a compressed byte stream into a global buffer: a negative control byte repeats the following byte, and a positive one copies that many literal bytes. It adds forty to a table entry on each row and repeats over a counted set of rows.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:98C6
name: search_for_bo_dy_marker
description: Advances through a word table until it finds the two-character sequence BO followed by DY. It stores nothing and returns.

name: copy_record_words_to_globals
description: Copies one word from a record at offset twenty-eight and another from offset two into two global variables.

name: initialize_audio_dma_tables
description: Clears a block of 52 longwords of globals and builds a table of cumulative word offsets from a source table. It installs a table of routine addresses, zeroes the four audio volume registers, sets a control variable, and writes CIA, DMA control and interrupt enable registers.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9A76
name: silence_audio_and_restore_state
description: Zeroes the four audio volume registers, clears a bit in a global control variable, and writes an interrupt-enable mask that disables one source. It then restores a saved global value.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9AAA
name: advance_sound_channel_events
description: Runs one sound update tick. While the tick counter is still running it does nothing more; otherwise it decodes the next event for each of four audio channels from a packed byte stream and dispatches special commands through a table. It updates the stream pointer and reloads the tick counter when the stream is exhausted.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9AEC
name: decode_sound_channel_stream
description: Continues decoding packed sound events for the channel loop, writing per-channel state words and pointers. It ends by returning or by calling a handler from a table.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9B0C
name: decode_sound_events_second_path
description: Decodes packed sound events for the channel loop through a second pointer, storing channel state and pointers. It returns or calls a table handler when a command byte needs special handling.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9B28
name: decode_sound_events_third_path
description: Decodes packed sound events for the channel loop with a third set of pointers, writing channel state and pointers. It returns or calls a table handler for special commands.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9B6A
name: call_indirect_command_handler
description: Makes an indirect call through a pointer whose table could not be recovered, then returns. The body has no other operations.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9BB4
name: resume_sound_event_decoding
description: Resumes decoding packed sound events at a point inside the channel loop, writing channel state and pointers. It returns or calls a table handler for special commands.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9BCA
name: decode_sound_events_outer_loop
description: Runs the outer loop of sound event decoding, reading packed bytes and writing channel state. It sets up the next channel and returns or calls a table handler.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9C2E
name: decode_sound_events_alternate_entry
description: Enters the packed sound event decoder at an alternate point, storing a channel word before decoding further events. It returns or calls a table handler for special commands.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9C36
name: store_byte_and_decode_sound
description: Stores a byte value into a sound record and then enters the packed sound event decoder. The decoder writes channel state and calls a table handler for special commands.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9C3E
name: set_sound_fields_and_decode
description: Writes fixed values into a sound record and then enters the packed sound event decoder. It sets a status byte and a byte offset before decoding continues.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9C4C
name: store_word_and_decode_sound
description: Stores a word into a sound record and then enters the packed sound event decoder. The decoder continues with channel state and table handlers.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9C54
name: set_sound_flag_and_decode
description: Clears one bit of a global control variable, ORs in a low byte from a register, and enters the packed sound event decoder.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9C66
name: finish_sound_channel_and_decode
description: Stores a word and an entry into a sound channel record, then enters the packed sound event decoder for the remaining events.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9C7C
name: enter_sound_decoder_at_loop
description: Stores a word into a channel record and enters the packed sound event decoder at the loop start. It continues with channel state and table handlers.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9C84
name: dispatch_first_active_channel_handler
description: Scans up to four channel records, spaced thirty-two bytes apart, for the first whose status value is from one to eight. It calls the handler selected by that value from a table and returns without calling anything if none match.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9CA4
name: dispatch_next_active_channel_handler
description: Steps through a counted run of thirty-two-byte channel records and calls the handler selected by the first status value from one to eight. It returns without calling anything when none match.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9CB2
name: slide_channel_value_down_clamped
description: Subtracts a per-channel step from a stored value and clamps the result to a minimum of 113. It then stores the value and calls the next channel handler from a table.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9CD0
name: slide_channel_value_up_clamped
description: Adds a per-channel step to a stored value and clamps the result to a maximum of 856. It then stores the value and calls the next channel handler from a table.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9CEE
name: set_channel_value_from_table
description: Looks up a value in a table using a channel field, offset by a scaled low nibble, and clamps the index to seventy-two. It stores the looked-up value in the channel and calls the next channel handler.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9D0E
name: apply_table_lookup_effect
description: Selects a table index from a global control byte and a channel field, clamps it to seventy-two, and stores the looked-up value in the channel. It then calls the next channel handler.

name: copy_channel_value_and_dispatch
description: Stores a channel's current value into the output record without change, then calls the next channel handler.

name: apply_table_scaled_modulation
description: Scales a value from a global table by a channel nibble, flips its sign by a channel flag and adds it to the channel's base value. It also advances a phase byte and calls the next channel handler.

name: reload_and_apply_table_modulation
description: Reloads a channel's step field when the command is non-zero, then applies a table-scaled modulation to the channel's value. It updates the phase byte and calls the next channel handler.

name: set_channel_value_from_difference
description: Sets a channel's output value to the difference of two register values, advances its phase byte and calls the next channel handler.

name: step_channel_amplitude_clamped
description: Adds a per-channel step to an amplitude byte. A negative result restores a saved level, while a positive one clamps the level to sixty-four before the next handler is called.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9DEE
name: store_saved_level_and_dispatch
description: Stores a saved value into the channel's output and calls the next channel handler.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9DFA
name: ramp_channel_to_target_step
description: Reloads the step when non-zero and moves the channel value toward its target by the step, stopping at the target. It updates the amplitude when the command byte is sixteen, then calls the next channel handler.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9E04
name: ramp_channel_toward_target
description: Moves the channel value toward its target by the stored step, stopping at the target, and updates the amplitude when the command byte is sixteen. It then calls the next channel handler.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9E36
name: ramp_channel_down_to_floor
description: Subtracts a step from a channel value and stops it at a floor, setting a finished flag when the floor is reached. It updates the amplitude when the command byte is sixteen, then calls the next channel handler.

key: blob (1993)(core design)[cr flt][t +7 atx][a]/Blob (1993)(Core Design)[cr FLT][t +7 ATX][a].adf:blob:0:9E5A
name: copy_channel_pointers_to_globals
description: Writes a sequence of table values and a constant into global variables. Its register facts point to DMA control, interrupt request and CIA timer registers.

name: copy_table_values_to_globals
description: Copies six table values and a saved value into global variables, then writes a constant to a global. Its register facts point to CIA interrupt control, and the same code is shared with a routine whose facts point to audio channel pointer and length registers.

name: copy_table_values_to_globals
description: Copies six table values and a saved value into global variables, then writes a constant to a global. Its register facts point to CIA interrupt control, and the same code is shared with a routine whose facts point to audio channel pointer and length registers.

name: wait_interrupt_bit_then_clear

key: runtime segment $080270-$080D90:0:0864

name: poll_helper_until_count_fifteen
